text:
kevin: seeing a big surge of alerts from inference-prod routing — ~120/min sustained, PD keeps paginating the same engine errors. not customer-facing yet but noisy.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-3821 created (inference-prod alert storm) — paging oncall.

sre-bot: machine: inference-node-12 high OOM+restarts, logs show KV cache thrash. trending since 10:03 PDT.

maria: copying — can we do a quick tactical silence while we triage? current churn is obscuring real ops pages.

jordan: +1. propose a temporary global silence for the alert group and enable dedupe window. would cut PD pain.

kevin: agree. quick plan: 1) create 30m PD silence for inference-prod alerts 2) add a short-term dedupe in alert router 3) spin up minimal dashboard for the noisy signal and customer impact.

maria: executing PD silence now:
```
/pagerduty silence --service inference-prod --duration 30m --reason "alert storm: tactical silence to reduce noise"
```

ops-bot: PagerDuty: Silence 30m created for service inference-prod by maria.

jordan: while silence is on, let's apply an alert router patch to dedupe by error fingerprint for 10m. patch looks like:
```
rule "router.dedupe_temp":
  match: event.service == "inference-prod"
  actions: 
    - dedupe_window: 10m
    - tag: "temp-squelch"
```

kevin: can someone push that in the router sandbox? this must be reversible.

maria: i'll push and monitor. deploying to canary router now.

oncall-bot: deploy started: router-canary -> sha: a1b2c3.

maria: canary looks good, dedupe metric dropped 60% after 90s. pushing to primary.

ops-bot: router primary updated. dedupe_window=10m active for inference-prod.

jordan: created an ad-hoc dashboard to track: alert rate, unique fingerprints, PD pages, and customer error rate: https://grafana.internal/d/alerts/inference-temp-watch

kevin: quick check on customer impact? any 5xx spikes in prod?

sre-bot: customer_errors 5xx rate: flat at baseline for last 15m. only internal engines are flapping.

maria: good. leaving the 30m silence but adding a 2hr followup ticket to harden alerting rules and adjust thresholds. i'll create the ticket.

maria: followup ticket created: RW-1942 "Alert tuning: dedupe policy and threshold adjustments for KV cache thrash". assigning to eng-ml+eng-runtime.

kevin: noted. actions for post-incident:
- run a short RCA on KV cache behavior
- consider cross-service rate-limits for alert emissions
- add fingerprinting to more error alerts

jordan: I'll prototype threshold change for the memory OOM alert to require a sustained 3m window rather than 30s. sample rule:
```
alert: InferenceOOMHigh
expr: node_memory_used_bytes / node_memory_total_bytes > 0.92
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
```

kevin: +1. leave notes in RW-1942.

oncall-next: taking handoff — i'll watch the dashboard for the next 30m and escalate if customer impact appears.

kevin: handing off to @oncall-next. i'm stepping out for a break, reach me if PD resumes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-3821 status: mitigated (noise reduced). silence expires in 18m.

maria: we should schedule an oncall walk-through tomorrow to go over the new dedupe knobs and runbook for noise events.

jordan: agreed. will add a short doc with router config snippets and a dashboard link.

kevin: thanks everyone. good fast mitigation — lowered PD blast radius without masking visibility on real customer errors.

oncall-next: ack, i'll update the shift log and close the incident when silence expires and metrics look stable. :white_check_mark:
